decisions.decision: D-NEW-01: Scene generation belongs to Phase 5 (chrome baked into diffusion output)
decisions.rationale: Programmatic chrome rendering accumulated repeated symptom fixes (Twemoji COLR swap, nav_easter_eggs removal, golden PNG regen, BGRA channel-swap) — architecture was wrong

decisions.decision: D-NEW-02: Compositor overlays text only; render-text-overlay.js survives, all chrome modules die
decisions.rationale: FLUX cannot reliably render multi-sentence satirical body copy with punctuation; text overlay is the one job the compositor must own

decisions.decision: D-NEW-03: Per-variant VARIANT_SLOTS constants in code (rejected scene-aware CV positioning and flux-krea sidecar JSON)
decisions.rationale: Each variant has fixed UI shell by template design; slots are pinned by prompt, not floating; simplest deterministic option

decisions.decision: D-NEW-04: Determinism contract split into REQ-X-052a (scene, Phase 5) + REQ-X-052b (overlay, Phase 4) with checked-in scene PNG fixture as handoff
decisions.rationale: Diffusion and canvas pipelines have entirely different determinism guarantees; cannot enforce byte-identical contract end-to-end

decisions.decision: D-NEW-05: Static archetype->variant table in Phase 2; image_seed.scene_template becomes enum; fallback B (executive strategy office)
decisions.rationale: B reads as the most generic professional LinkedIn baseline without coding to a specific psychological stereotype

decisions.decision: D-NEW-06: Post Brief schema bump to v2 (preferred over in-place v1 patch)
decisions.rationale: Breaking change to image_seed.scene_template field; honors lessons.md rule about explicit version bumps for contract changes

decisions.decision: D-NEW-07: Legacy compositor modules deleted from main (preserved on archive branch only), not retained as dead code
decisions.rationale: Honors global No Orphaned Code rule

decisions.decision: D-NEW-08: Cross-phase nav_easter_eggs removal retroactively justified — entire chrome path is gone
decisions.rationale: Removal stands; no further action needed
